{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any comma-separated values in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:")
print(df.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].unique())

# Strip commas and convert to float
# But only if there are actual commas
if has_commas.any():
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

print("\nAfter cleaning, first few revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())"}
